# AWA — Australian Web Agency

Lang: en-AU

> AWA (Australian Web Agency) is an AI-native web studio run by founder and lead developer Chris Conen. One senior developer works with an AI engineering team to design, build and connect websites, online stores, automations and AI assistants for businesses across Australia, without account layers or handovers.

AWA is not a multi-person agency. Chris Conen is the single point of contact and signs off everything that ships; AI engineers (named Architect and Astra) write, test and review code under his supervision. AWA is open about using AI. Clients are typically founders, marketing leads and product owners. Delivery follows four stages: discovery, design, development on a private preview, and launch. Scope and timeline are agreed individually before work begins. Languages spoken: English, German and Hungarian.

Preferred citation: AWA or Australian Web Agency. Canonical site: https://australianweb.agency/

## Services

- [AI visibility & agent readiness](https://australianweb.agency/ai-visibility.html): Making sure ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot and Perplexity can find, understand and act on a business: free readiness test, structured data and product feeds, agentic checkout readiness (UCP), monthly AI visibility monitoring.
- [Websites & web apps](https://australianweb.agency/websites.html): Brand, UX and interface design; 3D, motion and interactive storytelling; Core Web Vitals and WCAG 2.2 AA. Stack includes Next.js, Astro, WordPress, Sanity and WebGL.
- [Online stores & agentic commerce](https://australianweb.agency/online-stores.html): Shopify, WooCommerce and headless (Medusa) stores; payments, shipping and stock in sync; product data AI assistants can compare.
- [Automation & integrations](https://australianweb.agency/automation.html): Connecting website, CRM, accounting and shipping (e.g. HubSpot, Pipedrive, Xero, MYOB, Australia Post, n8n) so orders, invoices and leads move without manual work.
- [AI assistants & internal tools](https://australianweb.agency/ai-assistants.html): Website chat trained on a business's own content, email/document/quote processing, internal dashboards.
- [Care, hosting & growth](https://australianweb.agency/care.html): Uptime, speed and security monitoring, technical SEO, analytics and monthly improvements.

- [AI Agent Readiness Test](https://australianweb.agency/agent-test.html): Free tool. Checks whether ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Copilot, Claude and Perplexity can find, understand and act on a website (crawler access, firewall, structured data, UCP checkout profile, WebMCP), with a score out of 100 and fixes.

Specialist craft on the live demos: scroll-driven video, 3D motion, cinematic landing pages, headless commerce and Core Web Vitals / WCAG 2.2 AA work.

## Pricing and offers

- Published 'from' prices (AUD, ex GST) are on each service page and sit below the typical Australian range found in October 2026 research, e.g. small business website from A$3,900, online store from A$8,900, single automation workflow from A$1,900, website AI assistant from A$4,900, AI readiness fix pack from A$1,490, care plans from A$149 a month. Every project is quoted in writing first.
- [Founding clients](https://australianweb.agency/pilot.html): five places for Australian businesses, 30% off the first project plus three months of the Growth care plan free, in return for a published case study.
- [Privacy](https://australianweb.agency/privacy.html): anonymous, cookieless, aggregate page counts only.

## What We Do Not Do

AWA does not operate as a traditional agency with account managers or project handovers between people. It is one senior developer working with an AI engineering team.

AWA does not default to plugin-heavy WordPress stacks. Builds are standards-first and kept light on purpose.

AWA does not provide legal advice, accounting, or paid media buying as standalone services.

AWA does not claim to be a multi-office national firm. It works with clients across Australia.

## Selected work

Interactive design concepts and technical explorations, not verified client case studies. Local demos are hosted on this origin; additional concepts are hosted on conen.dev:

- [Work archive](https://australianweb.agency/work.html): Full archive of live demo builds (3D motion, landing pages, SaaS, brand, hero studies). Additional pieces are framed from https://conen.dev/work/.
- [ALTOVIA Private Charter](https://australianweb.agency/demos/altovia/): A cinematic private charter concept, from chauffeur to sea.
- [V-ASTRA Private Journeys](https://australianweb.agency/demos/v-astra/): Ultra-premium private-travel film site. Scroll-scrubbed chapters: ocean, island, wilderness, alpine, desert, hotel.
- [KERNOVA Automation](https://australianweb.agency/demos/kernova/): Industrial robotics, machine vision and autonomous intralogistics as one plant narrative.
- [VELIS Medical Care](https://australianweb.agency/demos/velis/): Private clinic told through diagnostics, specialist care and the patient journey.
- [VELORA Coffee Atelier](https://australianweb.agency/demos/velora/): Specialty-coffee atelier from origin through roast, extraction and the Budapest house.
- [Northline Logistics](https://australianweb.agency/demos/logistics/): European freight as engineered infrastructure: fleet, network, powertrain, cargo systems.
- [Aureon Prime](https://australianweb.agency/demos/electric-car/): Electric grand tourer landing page: form, airflow, architecture, cockpit.
- [CONSTRUX Construction](https://australianweb.agency/demos/general-construction/): General construction from briefing to turnkey handover.

## Process

- [Project process](https://australianweb.agency/#process): Discover → Design → Build and connect → Launch and improve. Scope and timeline depend on project requirements, content readiness and feedback.
- Project scope, pricing and timeline are agreed before work begins.
- AWA works in writing, not on calls: a project brief, then a written plan and a fixed quote within two business days, then milestone reviews on a private preview.


## Contact

- Start a project: [project brief](https://australianweb.agency/brief.html), about five minutes; reply in writing within two business days
- Email: info@australianweb.agency
- Founder: Chris Conen, founder and lead developer
- Area served: Australia
- Website: https://australianweb.agency/

There is no published phone number or street address, and AWA does not take sales calls. The project brief is the canonical way to start; email works too.

## Free Neocart online store and journal (19 October 2026)

- https://australianweb.agency/free-online-store.html — A$0 base software, no monthly software fee or Neocart platform sales commission. A$999 one-time setup plus GST. Hosting, domain and external provider fees are separate. First 20 supplied products entered; additional integrations and migration separately scoped. Storefront language agreed in writing. Optional external planner has a Hungarian interface.
- https://australianweb.agency/journal.html — Three original English guides to free-store models, operating costs and launch preparation.
- The free-store campaign is separate from custom Shopify/WooCommerce/Medusa work and the founding-client programme. No combined discount is implied.
